about: Round 12 (audio-modes): calls matched to how hard and how cleanly the ball was hit (six_huge / six_edge / four_cracking / four_placed / four_edge, picked by exit speed and timing in MatchDirector.CommentaryCalls.SixLine/FourLine), and two-voice exchanges: x?_<topic>_N (Arjun asks) is answered by xa_<topic>_N (Kiara) with the same N. English only. python -I tools/gen_commentary_r8.py --file commentary_more_en_5.json
six_huge: That is massive! Out of the ground!
Monstrous hit! That's gone a mile!
Huge! Right out of the middle, and into the night sky!
What a strike! That's one of the biggest sixes of the season!
He's absolutely creamed that! Way back into the top tier!
Gone! Gone! That's not coming back!
Pure power! Clean as you like, and it's sailed over the roof!
six_edge: Off the top edge, and it carries all the way for six!
He didn't time that at all, but it's six!
Miscued, and it still clears the rope! Lucky!
four_cracking: Smashed! The fielder didn't even move!
What a stroke! Like a tracer bullet to the fence!
Hammered through the off side for four!
That's pierced the field with real venom!
Bang! Four runs, and the bowler can only watch!
four_placed: Placed! Not hard, just perfectly into the gap.
Lovely touch. Guided away for four.
Just a caress, and it trickles over the rope.
four_edge: Edged, and it flies past the slips for four!
Thick edge, and it runs away to third man!
Not off the middle, but it'll count. Four!
Outside edge, and away to the boundary!
xq_six: Kiara, where did that one land?
Have you seen many bigger than that, Kiara?
Kiara, is the ball still in the ground?
xa_six: Somewhere in the top tier, I think! What a hit.
Not this season, no! That was enormous.
I'm not sure it is! They'll need a new one.
xq_wicket: Big wicket, Kiara. Is that the turning point?
Was that a good ball, or a poor shot, Kiara?
xa_wicket: He went too hard, too early. The bowler set him up.
It could be. The new batter has a lot to do now.
A bit of both, but the bowler earned it.
xq_chase: Kiara, who's ahead in this chase?
Can they still get there, Kiara?
xa_chase: It's balanced on a knife edge. One big over decides it.
They can, but they need a boundary soon.
